No Change for Large Bills ($50s or $100s):

We cannot make a change for bills larger than $20. We can accept $50s and $100s for payment, but we simply cannot make change for these bills.

## Town Clerk's Responsibilities

The Town Clerk's Office handles vehicle and dog registrations as well as processes vital records for the town. With the Town Moderator, we handle local, state, and federal elections.

## New to Town

Welcome! Please check out the New Resident Page to learn more about the Town Clerk's Office and how we may assist you!

Just so you know, we also offer online payments for all vehicle renewals, new and renewal dog licenses, and Vital Records Requests. Need to send us a note with the registrations. Don't miss the 'message an agent' dropdown when you are checking out online. (Note: A How-To add a message to online payments is at the top of the FAQ Registration and Titling Vehicles page.)

Many of the Clerk's duties can be handled through email (townclerk@townofdeerfield.org), phone or postal mail if physical presence if difficult.

Peddler Permits and Solicitors

  * Local Law 2 of 1996 states all solicitors advertising, selling of wares or services, must obtain a Peddler Permit from the Town of Deerfield. In exchange for this permit, the Town Clerk receives information on the company, solicitor, transportation information, and contact information. This is to keep track of those who travel through our town for the purposes of protecting our residents. You are free to ask to see their permits.

The Real ID Act

  * If your NYS license or ID does not have a star or a flag on it, then you do not have a REAL ID-compliant document. A REAL ID is a federally compliant DMV issues driver license, learner permit, or other non-driver ID that is required to board a somestice flight (within the U.S.) or enter certain federal buildings, unless you have a valid passport.

Clerk's Note:

Please note that one form of proff of ID id your legal name, which affects many women, as marriage and divorce changes out names. The DMV will ask you to provide proof of your past name changes, To do so, you must locate the town, city, or village where you obtained your marriage license and request a certified transcript. The cost is $10 to search and, if available, provide the transcripts. This procedure requires payment up front along with the application. Photo ID is required, with completed application. This procedure does take research and time. Please consider this at the time of the request. 

Bring Proof of Your Full, Legal Name

DMV may only print your legal name on a REAL ID or enhanced document. A nickname, like an abbreviated or alternate version of your legal name, is not allowed. If a nickname, abbreviated name, or confirmation name appears on any of your proof documents, additional proof of full, legal name, or proof of a court-ordered name change, must be shown.

If your name has changed once or multiple times due to marriage or divorce, for example, proof of each change,such as a marriage certificate or divorce decree, must be provided to show the connection.

# Elections & Voting

####             Registering to Vote     Absentee Voting     Election Results

* * *

### Need to Register to vote? Click Here for Information 

Please note that there is same day voter registration at the polls. The same information outlined in the above link is required at the polls for registration.

* * *

### Obtaining an Absentee Ballot Application

Note: All absentee ballot applications must be either mailed, emailed, faxed, or dropped off by the absentee voter requesting the ballot. A spouse may not drop off a completed application for their partner. (Please note that no electronic signatures are accepted on the application.)

 

Please note that absentee voting laws change effective September 30,2025. Voting absentee in person or requesting a form form the town's clerk's office will require that you provide ID. Please note that the New Hamphsire Secretary of States Office will update Absentee Voting Information on their website by September 12, 2025 with a new applicable laws.
